categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: petrochemicals and industrial gases. The petrochemical segment produces olefins (ethylene, propylene), basic petrochemical products (Mixed-C4, BD, BTX, EO/EG), and polymers such as polypropylene (PP) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE). The industrial gases segment, through its subsidiary Korea Air-Tech, manufactures and sells industrial and medical gases including liquid nitrogen, oxygen, argon, gaseous nitrogen and oxygen, as well as LPG and liquid carbon dioxide.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The petrochemical production relies on naphtha cracking (NCC) technology to produce olefins and monomers, followed by polymerization processes including slurry polymerization for HDPE and PP to ensure high product quality. The industrial gases are produced mainly by air separation technology, and liquid carbon dioxide is produced by capturing and purifying CO2 from petrochemical processes. The company also develops proprietary catalysts and polymer grades to enhance product performance and differentiation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include downstream petrochemical manufacturers, consumer product companies, and industrial users of polymers and monomers. The industrial gases segment serves industrial complexes and medical sectors domestically, supplying gases via pipelines under long-term contracts. Export markets are served through trading companies and distributors, with a focus on diversified geographic regions including China and offshore markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities located in Onsan and Ulsan industrial complexes. Its petrochemical products are sold domestically and exported internationally, including to China and other overseas markets. The industrial gases business serves primarily the domestic industrial complexes with no significant export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates vertically integrated production facilities from upstream naphtha cracking to midstream monomer production and downstream polymer manufacturing. It occupies a midstream to downstream position in the petrochemical supply chain, producing key raw materials and finished polymer products. The industrial gases segment operates downstream, supplying gases directly to end users in industrial and medical sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include capacity expansion of NCC and polymer plants, development of high-value specialty polymers, and diversification into new petrochemical products such as styrene monomer. R&D focuses on catalyst development, polymer grade innovation for applications like battery separators, films, and fibers, and process improvements for efficiency and environmental compliance. The company emphasizes close integration between R&D and production for rapid commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of petrochemical monomers, polymers, and industrial gases. Sales channels include direct sales to consumers, distributors, and exports via trading companies. The industrial gases segment relies on long-term supply contracts, often delivered via pipelines. Additional minor revenue streams include electricity sales and facility rentals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a significant domestic market share in ethylene (about 7%), propylene (5%), HDPE (18%), and PP (9%) production capacity. It competes with large multinational petrochemical and industrial gas companies, including Air Products Korea, Linde Korea, and Air Liquide Korea in the industrial gases market. Its vertically integrated production and proprietary technologies provide competitive advantages in product quality and cost efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 2.5 trillion in the latest fiscal year, with petrochemicals accounting for 97.9% and industrial gases 2.1%. Despite challenging market conditions, revenue grew by 12.5% year-over-year. Operating losses narrowed significantly due to cost reductions and increased sales of high-value products. Total assets are about KRW 2.2 trillion, with a stable capital structure and moderate leverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable and integrated supply of high-quality olefins and polymers with proprietary catalyst technology ensuring superior product properties. Its flexible polymer production system allows rapid adjustment to market demand and product mix, enhancing profitability. Specialty polymers for battery separators and high-performance applications differentiate its portfolio. The industrial gases segment offers reliable, long-term supply through pipeline infrastructure, supporting customer operational stability.
